mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above 2% annualized growth rate indicates a strong demand environment, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where unemployment rate is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above 2% monthly growth rate indicates a strong supply environment, leading to increased productivity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where industrial production growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between federal funds rate and CPI inflation rate signals a monetary policy response to inflationary pressures, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a strong demand environment, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when GDPC1 > 2% and HOUST > 1.2 million.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% and housing starts exceed 1.2 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in payroll employment below 100,000 indicates a weak labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where payroll employment is below 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between industrial production growth rate and RSAFS signals a strong supply environment, leading to increased productivity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when INDPRO > 2% and RSAFS > $400 billion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where industrial production growth exceeds 2% and RSAFS exceeds $400 billion.
